about: The saved shape of every standard statechart that saves, by its path in the repository (docs/adr/0045, "The shape of a tree"). A child's saved state is refused when the document it runs changed shape, so a standard statechart an application invokes is a promise about its shape: it changes only as docs/adr/0044 allows. An edit that moves one of these values refuses the saved states of every application that runs the statechart; a_standard_statechart_that_saves_keeps_its_shape fails on it here, in the repository, rather than on their devices. A new standard statechart that saves is added with its shape.
